name: Ai Yori Aoshi
source:
The game comes with two different story segments, South Island and Winter Lake.

South Island Edition 
During winter vacation, Tina sees a TV program about the balmy southern islands and says that she wants to go to the ocean. Aoi proposes that they go visit her villa in the southern islands.

They immediately board a cruise ship to make the journey to the island as a group. However, on the way the weather turns nasty and the ship capsizes. Miyabi calls for help, but the radio is broken and proves of no use. They are left wondering if a rescue team will come looking for them.

Winter Lake Edition 
During winter vacation, Tina sees a TV program about the warm southern islands and says that she wants to go to the ocean again. Kaoru points out that they just been to the ocean. With perfect timing, Mayu shows up to invite them to her vacation home for the holidays.

[From [url=http://www.rightstuf.com/1-800-338-6827/catalogmgr/e0lzw=EDevp8WeyKGn/browse/item/67389/4/0/0]Rightstuf[/url]]
translation:
游戏包含两个独立故事篇章：“南之岛”与“冬之湖”。

南之岛篇
寒假期间，蒂娜在电视上看到介绍温暖南方岛屿的节目，表示自己想去海边。葵于是提议，大家可以前往她位于南方岛屿的别墅。

一行人立刻登上邮轮，结伴前往小岛。然而途中天气骤然恶化，船只倾覆。神乐崎雅尝试呼救，无线电却已经损坏，根本派不上用场。众人只能忐忑地等待，不知道救援队是否会前来搜寻。

冬之湖篇
寒假期间，蒂娜看到介绍温暖南方岛屿的电视节目，又说想去海边。薰指出他们才刚去过海边。就在这恰到好处的时机，麻由现身，邀请众人去她的度假别墅共度假期。
